summary: Full re-verification of Files CRM RBAC + json_safe fixes on PREVIEW. Backend: 23/23 pytest passed (list 514, GP=15, TL=14, TL team_view=38, Manager=46, all 11 report endpoints 200, file detail loads for both UUID and 24-char ObjectId ids, PUT /files/{id}/details, PUT /files/{id}/file-status, POST /files/{id}/notes, GET /files/{id}/eligibilities, GET /files/{id}/activities, /api/users returns files_count AND leads_count). Frontend Admin: /admin/files renders Files (514) with 'Page 1 of 11', file rows visible, clicking a row opens FileDetailsPage with customer/employment/loan/lead sections + Documents + Profile Analysis (Save) + Bank Eligibilities (Save All) + Activity Log. Add Note POST -> 200, Edit Details PUT -> 200. Frontend GP (Nithin): lands on /agent with exactly '15 data assigned to you'. All bug-fix scenarios in the review request are verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: Newly added notes are not visible in the Activity Log after page reload even though POST /files/{id}/notes returns 200 and the note IS persisted in GET /files/{id}/activities (verified via pytest). Root cause: FileDetailsPage.js line ~1319 renders `activities.slice(0, 10)` — the API returns activities in chronological (oldest-first) order so on files with >10 activities the newest note gets truncated. Should either reverse-sort by timestamp desc before slicing, or slice from the end.

issues: Same React hydration warnings from prior iteration are still present in console (x-ve-dynamic <span> wrappers around <option>/<tr>/<tbody>/<tfoot>/<table>). Non-blocking dev-instrumentation noise. Already flagged in iteration_40.

action_items: Fix FileDetailsPage.js Activity Log to sort/slice so the newest note appears at top (activities.slice(-10).reverse() or sort by timestamp desc before slicing).
(Carry-over from iter 40) Investigate x-ve-dynamic span wrappers causing hydration warnings around option/tr/table children.
critical_code_review_comments: lead_filter() correctly matches by id or _id (ObjectId) — verified via file detail fetch for both UUID and 24-char ObjectId records.
json_safe() sanitiser is working — the Admin Files list endpoint that previously 500'd with NaN/Inf/ObjectId now returns 200 with total=514.
FileDetailsPage.js: `activities.slice(0, 10)` truncates newest notes when list has >10 items — bug for legacy files with many activities.
/app/backend/routes/files_crm.py is ~4200 lines — split into files_list.py / files_detail.py / files_reports.py / files_commissions.py to improve maintainability.
Admin Users API correctly exposes both files_count (status='file' only) and leads_count — matches spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_iter41_files_rbac.py — reusable for future Files CRM changes. Files list uses pagination.total (not top-level total). Files report endpoints live at /api/files/reports/* and /api/files/dashboard/stats (not /api/files/{name}). File detail activity log on the UI truncates newest notes when >10 activities exist — verify fix by adding a note on file 6d194952-c102-4c4b-89b4-7917c2f1fb02 which already has 7+ activities.
rca of the issue: The activity-log 'note not visible' UI symptom that appeared during frontend testing was NOT the backend bug from the review request (which is fixed). Its RCA: FileDetailsPage.js:1319 uses activities.slice(0, 10) with an oldest-first array from the backend, so any note added on a file that already has 10+ activities is silently hidden below the fold. Confirmed the note IS saved by hitting GET /api/files/{id}/activities directly — response contains 'TEST_iter41_note'. Fix: sort activities by timestamp desc before slicing (or slice(-10).reverse()).
